note: Family-run resort on Iron Lake just south of Iron River, with about 1,000 ft of shoreline. The lakefront sites look over the resort's own beach, docks and boat launch; most of the campground is in woods and open loops up the hill. Cabins are rented too. ATVs and UTVs may ride from the sites to the area trail network, but not within the resort. --Claude
summary: Operator 2026 rates/policies and camping page, RoverPass (unclaimed), Good Sam directory, Google 4.7 (203) and imagery read. $39 W/E, $45 FHU, lakefront $42-45: passes the price gate. flags: OHV FLAG (reviewer decides, not a drop): the operator markets trail access from the site - 'With hundreds of miles of the best ATV trails around, you can ride right from your campsite to the trails' and 'hundreds and hundreds of miles of beautiful trails accessible right from your cabin or campsite'. Riding inside the resort is banned ('limited to riding to and from the trails ONLY'). Primarily a lake resort (beach, docks, boat rentals, cabins), so it reads as a general campground with an OHV side.
